summary.en: CyberLink supports PowerDirector 2025, 2026 and 365 (22.6 or later) on Windows on Arm. Linaro lists it as running under emulation, and NVIDIA verified it.
summary.zh-TW: 訊連官方支援在 Windows on Arm 上執行威力導演 2025、2026 和 365（22.6 以上）。Linaro 目錄記錄它透過模擬執行，NVIDIA 也驗證過。

caveats.en: The AI Style plugin does not work, and BorisFX effects preview slowly. PowerDirector 2024 is not supported on Arm.
caveats.zh-TW: 不支援 AI 風格外掛，BorisFX 特效預覽會很慢。威力導演 2024 不支援 Arm。

evidence.title: CyberLink FAQ: What versions of CyberLink software support Windows 11 ARM platforms with Qualcomm CPU?
Works on WoA: Cyberlink PowerDirector 23.3.1614.0, emulation, verified by NVIDIA
